## Observable behavior

Describe the user-visible or API-visible result and the previous behavior.

## Scope and risk

List the changed product boundary, compatibility considerations, and remaining limitations.

## Tests actually run

List exact commands and results. Do not describe skipped or unavailable integrations as passing.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No external target was scanned, or the target and authorization are documented in a private maintainer record.
- [ ] No live Sniper database was used.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, customer code, generated evidence, or machine-specific paths were committed.
- [ ] Product behavior changes include a prior-behavior RED, a passing control, and an edge case.
- [ ] The Community release validator and relevant regression tests pass.
